raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (ingest 2026-01-19) delivers amounts with a leading '$' (e.g. '$40.14'), while earlier batches use plain decimals like '16.74'. The direct DECIMAL cast in silver_transactions fails on these values. Stripping the '$' before casting gives the intended amount, and a strict CAST will still fail loudly on any other unexpected format rather than silently nulling it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(amount, '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
